title: Authoring, Inspection, Search & Provenance UX
objective: Resolve bounded KFR authoring, inspection, search and provenance UX over completed KFR vocabulary, graph, records, transfer, qualification and owner-evidence integration without weakening visibility, provenance, owner authority or canonical mutation boundaries.

resolved_contract.projection_model: Visibility-safe read-only UX projection over explicit already-visible KFR-01 through KFR-06 data and source-owner evidence; filtering occurs before counts, search, inspection, provenance display, receipts and AI context.
resolved_contract.search_rule: Search, count, preview/inspection and AI-context derived outputs require the corresponding explicit visibility-projection authorization. A denied derived-output authorization yields no derived content and exposes no hidden cardinality.
resolved_contract.inspection_rule: Inspection is read-only and may display only already-visible entry detail, owner references and explicit provenance references. It cannot reveal hidden/private owner data or synthesize absent detail.
resolved_contract.provenance_rule: Provenance UX displays only explicit existing provenance references attached to visible inputs. Missing provenance remains visibly absent/unknown; KFR-07 never fabricates, infers or upgrades provenance.
resolved_contract.authoring_rule: KFR-07 may compose a draft/proposal authoring intent only when the relevant explicit AuthoringAuthority dimension decision is allowed. Authority dimensions do not inherit from one another. KFR-07 itself does not call AuthoringDraftPort or AuthoringProposalReviewPort mutation methods, publish, reveal, or canonical-promote anything.
resolved_contract.canonical_write_rule: Canonical KFR and source-domain writes remain with their existing owner ports. KFR-07 authoring UX is intent/proposal UX only and grants no canonical write authority.
resolved_contract.source_distinction: KFR-01 vocabulary/crosswalk, KFR-02 graph, KFR-03 records, KFR-04 transfer/confidence, KFR-05 qualification and KFR-06 owner-evidence integration remain separately labeled sources and are not flattened into a new truth owner.
resolved_contract.ordering_rule: Visible search results, inspection collections, provenance references and deterministic receipts use stable deterministic ordering independent of input ordering.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Hidden/private KFR and owner-domain inputs are filtered before topology/cardinality/search/autocomplete/count/preview/inspection/export/diagnostic/notification/receipt or optional-AI context; hidden cardinality is never exposed.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable KFR-07 persistence, duplicate index, provenance ledger or canonical write store; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.accessibility: Search result identity/source, inspection detail, provenance, authorization state and authoring-intent boundaries require accessible nonvisual equivalents.
resolved_contract.validation: Exactly one current KFR-07 Validation Core profile with zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine RED before production, then exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows and deterministic comparison.

preserved_boundaries: KFR-01 through KFR-06 remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
Canonical KFR owners, source-domain owners, AuthoringAuthority/AuthoringDraft/AuthoringProposalReview and Permission/visibility systems remain authoritative.
No canonical write, publish, reveal, canonical promotion, permission escalation, provenance fabrication, hidden-data reveal, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
KFR-08, ODL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
